title: Post sidebar

fields.label: Share buttons
fields.name: post_sidebar_networks
fields.instructions: Each button shares the current article. Copy link copies its permalink.

fields.label: Badge link
fields.name: post_sidebar_badge_url
fields.instructions: The badge is displayed only when this URL is filled in.

fields.label: Badge image
fields.name: post_sidebar_badge_image
fields.instructions: Select the badge image from the Media Library.

fields.label: Badge alternative text
fields.name: post_sidebar_badge_alt
fields.default_value: Add Velstadt as a preferred source on Google

fields.label: Subscription form shortcode
fields.name: post_sidebar_form_shortcode
fields.instructions: Copy the shortcode for Post sidebar subscription from Contact > Contact Forms. Edit its heading, description, button and policy links in Contact Form 7. Sidebar form classes are applied automatically. Newsletter service integration is configured separately.

description: Shared sidebar blocks for every blog post.
